claim: In a GetMetricData request, the maximum number of data points the request should return before paginating is an optional setting; if you omit it, the default of 100,800 is used.
note: The request parameter is named MaxDatapoints in the API reference (label line above the quoted description). Not found: a limit on the number of metrics per GetMetricData call; the API reference page only mentions the message 'Maximum number of allowed metrics exceeded'.
